high_court_outcome: Quashed the order and remanded the matter
neutral_facts: The case involves a dispute over the authenticity of a fax message related to financial transactions. The Enforcement Directorate conducted a search and seized the fax, which was alleged to be forged. The complainant claimed the fax was planted to frame him. An enquiry by the Enforcement Directorate confirmed the fax was forged. Respondent No.2, an official, confessed to forging the fax on instructions from respondent No.1. Respondent No.2 applied for pardon and became an approver, which was granted by the trial court. The High Court quashed the order and remanded the matter for reconsideration. The Supreme Court reviewed the case, considering the principles of public policy and the role of the court in granting pardon, ultimately dismissing the appeal and upholding the High Court's decision to remand the matter.
